title: Appl. New England Power & Massachusetts Electric Co. approval to participate in NEES MONEY POOL & to loan surplus funds to the pool.
filings: Massachusetts Electric Company, New England Power Company, Nantucket Electric Company, and New england Hydro- Transmission Electric Company, hereby file a report as to operation of the Money Pool of the National Grid USA companies during the year 2003. By James P. Meehan. DTE 01-104/ 589-A
